text:
Nora: Heads-up  Orbit QBR next Fri 2pm PT. Need a crisp 1-slide health snapshot, one-line renewal risk, onboarding ETA, and the actual exec ask. Can folks drop bullets by Tue EOD?

Ben: I'll take the health snapshot. Plan to show weekly MAU, 30d retention, and top error classes (connector timeouts + 429s).

Hana: I'll do onboarding status. Current cohort: 9 accounts, 6 green, 2 blocked on data mapping, 1 legal hold. Blockers look like SE bandwidth + one schema mismatch.

Omar: Renewal signal: one mid-market account is at RISK due to demo instability. I'll post the one-line for the slide.

Nora: Please keep the risk blurb to one sentence + one mitigation bullet. Execs want concise language.

Omar: "Renewal risk: RED  one mid-market account experienced repeated demo failures during exec POC; mitigation: propose 4-week canary Dedicated pool + prioritized SE time."

Ben: Quick ask on charts  do we want p95 latency vs target or simple avg latency? p95 preferred I think.

Nora: p95 please. Also add cost delta for the canary on the same slide (one line).

Hana: Onboarding ETAs: data mapping fixes = 7 business days if SE assigned, legal ETA 10 business days. I'll add named owners and the contact cadence.

Omar: I'll draft the exec ask wording: "Authorize 4-week canary Dedicated pool for top-5 accounts and up to 30 SE hours to resolve onboarding/demo blockers." Keep it short.

Ben: I'll highlight two routes: text.generate and embeddings.bulk-search. Also adding a small heatmap for error rates.

Nora: Logistics: deck link -> https://drive.redwood/Orbit-QBR-Quick (add slides by Thu noon); dry run Thurs 10am PT. ops-bot will create invites.

ops-bot: Created calendar event: Orbit QBR dry run  Thu 10:00 PT. Invitees: Nora, Ben, Hana, Omar.

Hana: Adding customer feedback snippets: 1) "speed and responses good" 2) "demo unreliable when connecting large datasets" (anonymized).

Ben: Uploaded p95 chart and small cost table. Can someone sanity check the cost delta on the exec ask slide?

Omar: Reviewed cost; will add expected SLA improvement numbers.

Nora: Final timeline: slides in Drive by Thu noon; dry run Thu 10am PT; final deck to exec Fri 11am PT. Thanks  ping me if you need data pulls. :thumbsup:

Hana: Done  added onboarding timeline and owner matrix to Drive.

Ben: Done  updated charts and labeled routes.

Omar: Uploaded the risk blurb and mitigation bullets.

Nora: Great. I'll assemble deck after dry run and send to execs.
